{{Quote|No, Shmorg, I've got it.|A Gran offers to buy drinks, as opposed to Shmorg|<ref name="DFG">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Shmorg''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operating on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Along with four other Gran, Shmorg attended a [[Barons Hed tavern|local]] [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]], where they ordered several refreshments. When Shmorg offered to pick up the tab, [[Unidentified Gran (Barons Hed)|another Gran]] opted to [[Currency/Legends|buy]] the drinks instead, a move with which Shmorg did not agree. All of the Gran became involved in an argument over who was going to pay for the drinks, which resulted in an [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed brawl]]. Shmorg's fight was ended by the novice [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the Gran when they turned to attack him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I wish he wouldn't shoot paying customers.|The bartender, on Kyle Katarn, after the latter killed Shmorg and his partners|audio=BaronsHedBartender-PayingCustomers.flac|<ref name="DF2" />}}
[[File:Barons_Hed_Bar.png|thumb|left|225px|The Barons Hed bar that Shmorg patronized and perished in.]]
The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]<ref name="DF2" /> Shmorg<ref name="DFG" /> was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="DFM">The ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' [[Star Wars video games|game]] manual identifies all [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] in the game as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].</ref> who was hired by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="DF2" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Along with numerous other [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters, Shmorg's job was to prowl the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]],<ref name="DF2" /> which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="SotE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> for intruders looking to infiltrate [[Government House (Sulon)|Government House]], a large facility located in the center of the city. One [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Shmorg and four other Gran bounty hunters headed to a local [[Barons Hed tavern|tavern]], where they ordered drinks from the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Barons Hed bartender|bartender]]. When the Gran had finished their refreshments, Shmorg offered to pick up the tab but was countered by another [[Unidentified Gran (Barons Hed)|Gran]], who also wanted to pay the bill. This led to an argument between all of the Gran over who was going to pay, which eventually escalated to an [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed brawl]] between them,<ref name="DFG" /> in which they began to beat each other to [[Death/Legends|death]]. The [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] frantically called for the Gran not to use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], although none of them were armed, with the sole exception of one Gran who was near a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] lying on the ground.<ref name="DF2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II}}
Just as the brawl began, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agent and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trainee]] [[Kyle Katarn]] stumbled into the [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] while attempting to [[Mission to Sulon|locate]] a way into Government House. By this point, two of the Gran had been beaten to death, and the remaining Gran turned their attention with clenched fists to Katarn. However, their attack proved unsuccessful, and the novice Jedi slew the other bounty hunters. Katan then collected the thermal detonators and the bar's supply of [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] before leaving, while the bartender grumbled their displeasure at Katarn for killing paying customers.<ref name="DF2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No blasters! No blasters!|The bartender, as Shmorg's fight broke out|audio=BaronsHedBartender-NoBlasters.flac|<ref name="DF2" />}}
Shmorg had [[Color/Legends|brown]]-colored skin and purple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DF2" /> Shmorg was a brawler with large [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. Although Shmorg was gracious enough to offer to pay the tab for his acquaintance's drinks, they did not tolerate another Gran offering to buy the refreshments instead.<ref name="DFG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Shmorg could throw hands.<ref name="DF2" />

==Equipment==
Shmorg wore predominantly brown and black [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] the day they died, which included [[Boot/Legends|boot]]s and gaiters.<ref name="DF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In any case, if Gran are stupid enough to kill each other, be smart enough to let them.|Rick Barba, ''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide''|<ref name="DFG" />}}
Shmorg appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as an anonymous enemy character in the game's fifth level. Shmorg received a name in the game's accompanying [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], although it is not clear which Gran in the bar is Shmorg. In the guide, author [[Rick Barba]] theorized that the Gran were fighting over a bar tab. He advised the player to wait out their fight until at least two Gran were dead and then kill the remaining Gran before pillaging the bar's supplies.<ref name="DFG" /> However, because completion of this encounter is not necessary for beating the game, it can be skipped without any negative effects.<ref name="DF2" />
